purpose: Descriptive live-topology overlay for the three existing Flutter roots. It binds product, privileged Owner/Friend, and V3 compatibility surfaces to explicit runtime authorities without replacing existing feature-convergence or release contracts.
rules: A production defaults to the canonical Render Research OS API.
B may retain a separate privileged Owner/Friend service, but Research OS auth/chat/data calls must have an explicit production binding to the canonical Render API.
C remains compatibility-scoped and must not become a second public product authority.
Local loopback defaults are development bindings only and must never be silently treated as production evidence.
Unknown or implicit endpoint ownership is a drift finding.
This overlay does not change the feature classification authority of the existing convergence map.

auto_repair.policy: Only uniquely deterministic, non-protected path/reference repairs may be proposed automatically. Endpoint/auth authority changes require explicit review.

evidence.authority_note: Evidence proves reconciliation state; evidence does not grant merge or release authority.
